scripts.serve:prod: ng build --configuration production && npx http-server dist/your-app-name -p 4200 -c-1
scripts.serve:prod:no-cache: ng build --configuration production && cd dist/your-app-name && npx http-server -p 4200 -c-1 --proxy http://localhost:4200?
scripts.test:sw: npm run build:prod && npm run serve:prod:no-cache
